name: CSC Steel Holdings Berhad
summary: CSC Steel Holdings Berhad functions as an investment holding entity, specializing in the manufacturing and distribution of steel coils across Malaysia and the broader Asia Pacific region. Its product range encompasses hot rolled pickled and oiled steel, which is suitable for vehicle underbodies, automotive wheels and interior parts, strapping, tubing, and racks. The company also supplies cold rolled steel products, essential for diverse sectors including automotive, domestic appliances, drums, pipes, tubes, steel furniture, and office equipment, and also serves as a base metal for coated steel. Additionally, it offers hot-dipped galvanized steel under the "Realzinc" brand and pre-painted galvanized steel, known as "Realcolor," which is utilized in construction materials such as awnings, roofing, cladding, and wall panels. Medium and high carbon steel are also part of its offerings. Beyond its industrial activities, the firm manages real estate properties. Incorporated in 2004 and headquartered in Ayer Keroh, Malaysia, the company was formerly known as Ornasteel Holdings Berhad before adopting its current name in June 2008.
